newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pathe buys TV channel from Landmark.
newsitem.headline: Pathe buys TV channel from Landmark.

text.p: French media company Pathe said on Wednesday it had bought the "Voyage" television channel from Landmark Communication Inc of the United States.
Pathe, created out of the break-up of the Chargeurs holding group last year, gave no financial details in a statement announcing the purchase.
But it said the deal confirmed its aim of participating in digital television through programming.
"Voyage" television airs programmes exclusively on tourism and leisure and is seen in France and Europe as well as other parts of the world, Pathe said.
